title: Start-of-shift clean-up (8.30am)
keywords: 8.30am morning expired jobs open lalamove unanswered whatsapp undelivered item picked last 5 days non-repostable
body: At 8.30am clear: expired jobs, open Lalamove jobs, unanswered WhatsApp, undelivered or item-picked jobs from the last 5 days, and non-repostable cancellations.
9–10am: identify moved-over jobs and make them the priority to clear the same day.
From 10am, every 2–3 hrs: check non-repostable, expired and expiring jobs.
